reviews: Huge bowls of broth for cheap, and the patio catches the afternoon sun.
Staff said the whole kitchen is peanut-free, which is rare around here.
Their noodles come smothered in house satay sauce. Peanuts in everything, no complaints.
Ate outside under the string lights. Great for a quick bowl.
Cozy basement noodle bar. No windows, but the broth is worth it.
Menu marks allergens clearly. Nothing with nuts.
Slices the size of your head, eaten at picnic tables out front.
No nuts anywhere on the menu, which is great for my allergy.
